references.text: Parallel account where Othniel, son of Kenaz, captures the city and receives Achsah as his wife as a reward from Caleb.
Caleb's promise to give his daughter Achsah to whoever captures Kiriath-sepher, which is the background for Othniel's conquest.
Othniel, son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, is described as Israel's first judge who delivered the people from oppression.
Caleb, son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, is mentioned as a faithful man who followed the Lord wholeheartedly and is Othniel's brother.
Background story about Caleb and his inheritance in the land, explaining why he could promise his daughter to whoever captured the city.
Genealogical reference mentioning Othniel as son of Kenaz in Judah's lineage.
